message: 幼馴染みは一心同体？

name: Synn
message: 「Fwaaaah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pull yourself together, Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nice try!」
I sidestep gracefully.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You dodged it!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Heh heh heh. I can read whatever you're about to pull, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if you're awake enough for that, I guess I don't need to worry」

name: Synn
message: 「Truth be told, I'm a little sleepy, but today's the deadline for submitting the proposal」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmmmm. So you remembered」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I did! I practically pulled an all-nighter for it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's our Student Council President! Way to go!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You oughta get that stuff out of the way before you're forced into an all-nighter」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn's the type who only starts his summer homework after summer break is already over, so」

name: Paqy
message: 「Guess it can't be helped then」

name: Synn
message: 「I was busy with my part-time job over summer break, so I didn't have time for homework. Ah, my gray, dreary summer vacation...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everything's sparkling and shining for you right now, though, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. That's why I've gotta fire myself up. For the sake of a sparkling, radiant school life!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Forget about that--you won't believe what happened on this morning's 'Folks of Faltering Love'」

name: Synn
message: 「'Forget about that,' she says」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, seriously, it was amazing. A handsome guy wearing a red padded vest suddenly showed up and slapped Miyuki-chan with a white glove」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa. That's way too out of left field!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is something the matter, Mr. President?」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't tell me you stayed up all night putting together the Charity Bazaar proposal yesterday」

name: Misa
message: 「You probably just forgot the notebook with the agenda written down」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah. H-How did you know!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ehh. That was actually true!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is what you call a true word spoken in jest」

name: Synn
message: 「I have to hurry back home」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No need to worry」

name: Synn
message: 「That's the notebook of legend!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You left it open on your desk when you headed out, so I brought it along」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw, shucks, we're childhood friends after all」

name: Ria
message: 「Having a childhood friend is so nice」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why he never develops any independence! Nanaka-san, even if you're childhood friends, you shouldn't bail him out. It'll only polish his hopeless good-for-nothing streak」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, they're childhood friends. Having her wake him up is practically the default」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not every day」

name: Misa
message: 「I should hope not」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A childhood friend is truly a must-have. They are far more potent than an alarm clock」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gotta admit, Soba's chops pack a serious punch」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My guidebook stated that childhood friends offer full-service care, such as coming to wake you up and making breakfast」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd really like to take a look at this guidebook of yours sometime」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I will not show you, as it would burn your eyes out」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't use something like that as a reference」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I would like one childhood friend for myself as well. Would you be willing to hand yours over」

name: Nanaka
message: 「As if I could be handed over!」

name: Ria
message: 「No can do, Lolotte-chan. A childhood friend isn't something you can get without putting in the years」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even an instant one would be fine, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Man, I wanna be Ria-chan's childhood friend」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you wanna be one that badly, why don't you just decide you're childhood friends starting right now」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. I think I'll pass on that」

name: Paqy
message: 「Gah! Though getting the cold shoulder kind of hits the spot too」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... Paqy-san, why is it that you look so cute on the outside, yet you're such a pervert on the inside?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone has a lot to say, but there is no high or low status among childhood friends」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there's no high or low status, sure, but 'instant' isn't right either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Before that, there's no such thing as an instant childhood friend in the first place」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the one who just said they could become childhood friends starting now, Nanaka-san!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, he was being so noisy, it just slipped out」

name: Misa
message: 「Please don't go making Onee-sama someone's childhood friend on such a whim」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right. An instant childhood friend is no good after all. Additive-free and pesticide-free is the way to go」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, childhood friends don't have pesticides on them」

name: Lolotte
message: 「True enough. My childhood friend is also additive-free and pesticide-free. All-natural」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like I said, that's just normal」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder what a childhood friend loaded with additives would even be like?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To put it bluntly, you eat 'em and die?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Are you going to eat Nanaka-chan?」

name: Misa
message: 「How filthy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san seems like she's loaded with additives, so President-san is going to die, isn't he」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you mean, loaded with additives!」

name: Synn
message: 「Before that, I'm not going to eat her」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I do have someone I've been with since we were little, though she won't wake me up in the morning or feed me, so it's a shame she doesn't cater to my every whim... sigh」

name: Misa
message: 「'Too bad'? People don't normally do that. Honestly, where do you even get your ideas, Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, Mr. Treasurer takes care of everything for you, doesn't he?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, he doesn't take care of everything! All he does is make soba!」

name: Synn
message: 「And she won't even drink the milk, even though I've got plenty of it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't want any!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hear that a special childhood friend wakes you up with a morning kiss」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha-wha-wha-wha-what?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Whoa. You're quite the precocious one, Synn-kun」

name: Misa
message: 「How filthy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I didn't, I didn't, I told you I didn't!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was just a momentary lapse of judgment!」

name: Synn
message: 「A momentary lapse of judgment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's nothing!」

name: Ria
message: 「A kiss in a momentary lapse of judgment! So Nanaka-chan was the precocious one all along」

name: Misa
message: 「How shameless」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I wouldn't do that even in a momentary lapse of judgment!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Listen up! Synn and I aren't special or anything--we're just your run-of-the-mill, everyday childhood friends!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How spoiled of you. Just having a childhood friend already makes you a winner at life」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it is? To think I was a winner at life...」

name: Misa
message: 「You're deluding yourself」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You are deluding yourself」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm, I don't think you need to shut him down quite that bluntly, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even sweet little Ria-chan has to phrase it as a question」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, whatever, having one is better than not having one」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plus, this one comes with soba」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. A childhood friend who comes with a nice little bonus.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The way you put that makes it sound kind of cheap...」
